cohort: The study included 180 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who underwent cesarean sections, divided into an infected group (n=60) and a non-infected control group (n=120).
finding: Prophylactic antibiotic use was found to be a protective factor against surgical site infections, while frequent examinations, amniotic fluid contamination, premature rupture of membranes, and genital tract inflammation significantly increased the risk of infection in GDM patients undergoing cesarean sections.
